author: arashkrad
quote:
After 16 hours of GTA 6, here's my honest review:

Gameplay: 4/10
Story: 3/10
Characters: 4/10
Character Development: 3/10
OST: 2/10
Graphics: 7/10
Map Design: 5/10
Mission Design: 3/10
Driving: 5/10

Overall: 3.5/10

Honestly, pretty disappointing experience. The game feels ridiculously forced in its woke and LGBTQ+ agenda, to the point where it genuinely gets annoying and takes away from the experience. So much of it feels unnecessary and poorly implemented.

After 13 years of waiting, this is what we got? Definitely not worth the hype or the wait.
